historical_references.reference: Tolentina was the name of an ancient Roman city located near the Tyrrhenian Sea. It was an important port city in the Roman Republic and later the Roman Empire. Tolentina was also known as Talentum, a name derived from the Etruscan word for 'mound', referring to a sacred hill in the city.
